findings.why: The prompt contains an article error caused by noun substitution.

findings.suggested_repair: Later targeted repair: change only the article to “An air-hockey puck…” and preserve the physics task.

findings.title: Mapped instructional variation is not realized
findings.why: Three mapped instructional variants use the same vector-diagram explanation task even though the audited map assigns meaningful variation axes.
findings.evidence: PS2/PS3/Extra all ask students to explain when one-dimensional force magnitudes are added or subtracted using effectively the same stimulus architecture; mapped variation includes evidence-set/context/misconception/representation changes.
findings.suggested_repair: Later repair one or more siblings so the evidence set or misconception target actually changes while the same I-can/difficulty is preserved.

findings.title: Mapped instructional variation is not realized
findings.why: The mapped vocabulary-role variants are functionally the same matching task; reordering the vocabulary list does not realize the intended variation.
findings.evidence: PS2 and Extra are text-identical; PS3 only reorders the same four terms while asking for the same four role matches. The audited map calls for evidence/context/misconception variation.
findings.suggested_repair: Later repair one or more siblings with a genuinely different classification/evidence structure rather than a term-order change.

findings.title: Force arrow slightly clips SVG boundary
findings.why: A force-arrow endpoint extends slightly outside the SVG viewBox, so the arrowhead can be clipped at the boundary.
findings.evidence: Coordinate audit found a line endpoint just beyond the top edge of the canonical SVG (roughly 2 px, with one seed about 1.7 px).
findings.suggested_repair: Later targeted repair: add viewBox padding or shorten/reposition the rendered arrow without changing the labeled force magnitude or physics.

findings.title: Summative Q03 secure semantic clone family
findings.why: One or more same-day Summative parallels reuse the same semantic question shell; object/number/direction swaps alone do not establish secure independence under the current Physics Framework.
findings.evidence: V1–V4 Q03 preserve the same evidence/reasoning architecture for the affected forms. The current secure rule requires genuinely different stimuli/representations/reasoning structures, not only noun, number, unit, direction, or choice-order changes.
findings.suggested_repair: Later secure-bank repair: preserve the exact I-can and difficulty, but author a genuinely different evidence stimulus and/or reasoning structure for the affected same-day forms.

findings.title: Summative Q03 mapped variation under-realized
findings.why: The affected Summative parallel slots do not visibly realize the audited map’s planned variation axes strongly enough.
findings.evidence: For Q03, mapped same-day parallels call for meaningful evidence/context/misconception/representation variation; the affected forms retain the same semantic shell as a peer.
findings.suggested_repair: Later repair the affected parallel(s) so the mapped variation is visible while maintaining the same evidence target and approximate difficulty.
